Strike in Riyadh
Oil barely blinked

lines.text: A deadly strike hit Riyadh's airport. Oil barely blinked.
lines.say: A deadly strike hit Riyadh's airport. Oil barely blinked.

lines.text: Oct 10: a Houthi-claimed strike on Riyadh's main airport killed at least 12 and wounded 300+.
lines.say: On Saturday, a Houthi-claimed strike on Riyadh's main airport killed at least twelve people and wounded over three hundred.

lines.text: Brent topped out at $105.63 overnight, less than 1% above Friday's $104.72 close (ICE futures).
lines.say: Overnight, Brent topped out near a hundred six dollars, less than one percent above Friday's close.

lines.text: Why so calm? The airport strikes didn't hit oil sites, and no Saudi exports were reported lost this weekend.
lines.say: Why so calm? The airport strikes didn't hit oil sites, and no Saudi exports were reported lost this weekend.

lines.text: But oil was already high: Brent averaged about $114 in September vs about $71 in February (EIA).
lines.say: But oil was already high. Brent averaged about a hundred fourteen dollars in September, versus about seventy-one in February.

lines.text: That price flows into gas pumps, plane tickets and shipping costs.

lines.text: It's Columbus Day: the bond market is closed, stocks are open. Banks report from Tuesday, CPI on Wednesday.
